channel.title: healthviz
channel.description: A playground of interactive visualisations built on open European health data. Each assessment takes one question and the public data to answer it.

item.title: Who can't get the care they need, and why?
item.description: How many people in each European country go without a medical or dental examination they need, whether it's the cost, a waiting list or the distance, and how much that depends on income.

item.title: Will your doctor retire soon?
item.description: How many of each European country's doctors are 55 or over, and whether its medical schools turn out enough graduates to replace them.

item.title: When does Europe retire, and how many healthy years are left at 65?
item.description: When people in each European country start their pension, and how many years at 65 they can expect to live in good health, shown year by year.

item.title: How much does Europe spend on health, and who pays?
item.description: Health spending per person in every European country since 2016: how much people pay out of their own pocket, and what the money goes to, from hospitals to long-term care.

item.title: Where in Europe do people live longest?
item.description: Life expectancy at birth in every European region since 2002, for women, men and in total, and how far apart regions within one country are.
